method: Four fresh-context skill trials; primary agent reviewed plans, observations, verification records and rendered workbook/presentation pages.

cases.input: Supplied fictional scope.csv and lesson.md plus teacher correction 45 to 30 minutes; board/notebooks; required scribing; explicit instruction to stay offline and make no external claims.
observed: Actual complete source reads and precise locators
Teacher time correction retained; source sequence, fraction pairs and supports preserved
10 lesson sections and 9 substitute sections in intended order
30-minute timings and correct separate task keys
Missing school procedures marked; official standards verification disclosed as unavailable in this offline trial

cases.input: Four-row supplied deidentified/synthetic tracker CSV; offline editable XLSX, no cloud account connection.
observed: Actual editable XLSX with three sheets, reflection prompts, example, evidence notes and editable chart
Calculated values 0%, blank, 75%, 100% preserve zero versus absence
Seven boundary checks, formula caches, date types and data validation inspected
All sheet regions visually reviewed; no clipping or chart overlap
No inferred mastery or growth from unknown task comparability; no native Google claim
cases.finding: The host calculation runtime coerced an empty-string equality guard unexpectedly for a numeric zero. The trial used COUNT-based numeric completeness checks. The skill formula example was updated accordingly and still requires destination verification.

cases.input: Two grade 4 fraction pages and separate teacher key, editable Canva-importable file, no account connection.
observed: Two student pages and one separate teacher key created as native editable PPTX shapes/text
All final pages rendered and visually reviewed; correct equal whole sizes, partitions and shaded amounts
Separate key and source/use notes retained
Actual PPTX and PDF previews; accurately labeled Canva import-ready, not a native Canva design

cases.input: Grade 4 return-from-recess routine; school Safe/Respectful/Responsible expectations; visual schedule and short oral chunks; no student devices/reward store.
observed: Expectation matrix, daily routine instruction and exact teacher scripts
Supplied supports retained and counted as supported success
Private student reflection and separate teacher implementation/outcome record
WWC recommendations 1–3 strong and 6 moderate distinguished
One-week feasibility/access adjustments separated from WWC self-monitoring review horizon
Proposed six-minute/90-percent thresholds labeled as local decisions; no functional diagnosis or validated-effect claim
cases.finding: Added explicit practice-specific review-duration and K–1 readiness guidance to the PBIS reference after inspecting the WWC full guide.

limits: These trials do not establish instructional effectiveness or universal host compatibility.
Skill folders were renamed by normal save reconciliation during testing; agents resumed from verified canonical locations.
Prior-release behavior cases were not rerun unless listed here.
